items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Adderly's Cannonball's father was in that.

ctx.x: His father? Saxophone. But he was a school teacher. That's the reason Cannonball was a school teacher. He's not an ignorant man; the man taught school.
Now when you came - you worked in Omaha but you heard about all these great things happening down in Kansas City. Now when did you come down to Kansas City and who did you join down there?
